basis: The chart displays the 'Reported reduction share (%)' for each program. The bar heights visually correspond to the printed percentages above each bar. The largest printed percentage is 41.2%, which is directly above the 'Building retrofits' bar. This is the largest value among all programs shown. The task requires routing the program with the largest contribution to the accelerated program review queue.
